description: Architecture baseline and build authorization policy. It decides which architecture decisions and gates must be satisfied before implementation or deployment of a given kind of work may be authorized, and which paths that work covers. It is a control-plane file: changing it changes what CI authorizes, so it is changed only by a reviewed pull request, and a baseline records its hash, so a baseline made under an older policy stops being current when this file changes. THIS FILE IS A PROPOSAL: the gate groupings below are taken from docs/phase/PHASE-1-BLOCKER-REPORT.md (gates G1 to G6) and ADR 0020, which are themselves not yet approved. The owner must review it before the first baseline is authorized (TODO T66). It never grants anything: it only describes what must be true before a human signs.
